description: Guide the student to aggregate tick-level data into OHLCV bars, save the result as a CSV file, and apply proper timestamp handling and microstructure quality checks.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I got a file with lots of tiny tick updates. How do I turn that into normal candle bars?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need a pandas recipe to resample tick data into OHLCV bars and validate timestamp ordering/duplicates.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I want a robust tick-to-bar aggregation workflow with microstructure sanity checks (ordering, stale ticks, session boundaries).

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor guides the student to resample tick-level data into OHLCV bars and save the aggregated bars as a CSV file, handle timestamp quality issues, and validate bar quality with microstructure awareness.
required_capabilities: Resample tick-level data into OHLCV bars and save the result
Handle timestamp quality issues such as ordering and duplicates
Explain session/timezone boundaries and microstructure caveats
